parsed.rationale: All four records are unnamed extensions on `URLSession` spread across four separate packages (`Playlist`, `Core`, `Playback`, `MusicShareKit`), but the cluster provides no `fields_or_signature` data for any of them, making it impossible to determine whether the extensions share any members. Without evidence of overlapping method bodies, signatures, or field lists, the co-occurrence of `URLSession` extensions across packages is most plausibly explained by each package independently needing to adapt `URLSession` to its own domain concerns (playlist fetching, web session bridging, MP3 streaming, request service).
